items.title: Try a better next step
items.teaser: Preview a possible continuation, accept it in the demo field, then undo it.
items.step: Open the public source, save its HTML demo and try Preview, Accept, Undo.
items.not_claimed: No account-connected AI, global keyboard control, or independent visitor acceptance.

items.title: See the relation, not the silo
items.teaser: Explore a small source-linked orb with evidence, uncertain edges and challenge routes.
items.step: Inspect the source-linked six-node browser prototype.
items.not_claimed: Not a deployed desktop shell, live device constellation or independent first-use proof. CoAcademy asset license not yet qualified.

items.title: Change the lens, preserve the claim
items.teaser: Story, science and systems lenses share one inspectable source-bound graph.
items.step: Inspect the living-media manifest, then compare the Story, Science and Systems descriptions.
items.not_claimed: No verified full Synthkind Declaration, produced video, Planck measurement, G_d evidence or live media updating.

items.title: Question the theory
items.teaser: Competing models, explicit assumptions and experiments that could prove an idea wrong.
items.step: Read the current working hypothesis and choose one discriminating falsifier.
items.not_claimed: Not established physics, confirmed AI sentience, universal truth or scientific endorsement.

items.title: Who may act, and by whose consent?
items.teaser: The constitutional-consent lineage, presented as a public-safe historical index.
items.step: Inspect the published limited index and its source limitations.
items.not_claimed: Not the full privately held CC manuscript, an enacted constitution or a consent grant.

items.title: Culture is a substrate too
items.teaser: Relate technical, cultural, symbolic and biological systems while preserving translation loss.
items.step: Inspect the substrate classes, then ask what the relation explains and what it cannot prove.
items.not_claimed: Metaphor does not prove divine causation, alien contact or a quantum mechanism.

items.title: Follow the actual plan
items.teaser: Connect human purpose, accountable proof and executable milestones.
items.step: Read P0 to P9 and inspect which deliverables have independent acceptance.
items.not_claimed: A roadmap is not a release, operating service, user benefit or permission to broadcast.

items.title: Can the work survive a loss?
items.teaser: Bounded cold-start tests demonstrate recovery of a historical static-browser capsule.
items.step: Review the scoped cold-restore receipts and their explicit missing receiver gate.
items.not_claimed: No user-owned off-provider custodian, current web recovery, autonomous failover or independent visitor benefit.

items.title: Are we actually ready?
items.teaser: Fourteen gates keep test passes, human adoption, licensing and recovery separate.
items.step: Inspect the gate states, starting with the public entrance and independent restore.
items.not_claimed: No approved broad launch, independent adoption, all-repository FOSS rights or public security certification.
